findings.title: Suspicious DNS query characteristics detected (Potential DNS Tunneling / DGA)
findings.description: Observed 110 DNS queries from 10.0.5.120 with abnormal structural properties (excessive string length and/or elevated Shannon entropy in subdomain prefixes), frequently associated with data staging over DNS or algorithmic domain generation.

findings.title: High DNS query volume from client host
findings.description: Host 10.0.5.120 generated 110 DNS queries (20.2 queries/sec) requesting 110 unique domains. Elevated query volume may warrant investigation into local background processes or C2 polling.
